entities.summary: Margaret Nyakang'o, is an accountant, financial manager and civil servant in Kenya, who beame the "Controller of Budget of the Republic of Kenya", in December 2019, the second person to serve in that capacity, since the office was established. She was sworn into office on 4 December 2019, having been approved by Parliament, the previous day. Immediately prior to her current assignment, she was a director at the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS).
